verdict.rationale: First-party docs only say Teams delivers meetings and calling, without mentioning screen sharing. Community reports confirm the feature indirectly: users describe presenting their desktop with annotation layered on top, and one notes the screen-sharing button is disabled in Firefox ESR, which implies it works in supported clients but not in some browsers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-call screen sharing, evidence of admin controls over sharing, and consistent cross-browser support.
